BeTranslated: Spanish translation agency
At BeTranslated, Spanish is one of our six major languages. Our boutique translation agency, which is based in Spain itself, has a vast network of native Spanish-speaking translators and certified translators of the Spanish language.
We provide sworn and certified translation services approved by the MAEC (the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs) for relocation purposes in Spain.
We understand the linguistic and cultural differences between the various Spanish-speaking markets, tailoring our professional translations to your specific needs and target audience.
We pride ourselves on providing affordable and quality Spanish translation services. Thanks to our unique agency structure and workflow, we can streamline costs so that we can offer you high quality language services at a very good rate.
From PDF translations to website localisation, we work with all types of formatting. We engage in a constant dialogue with our clients so that we can meet their needs to the best of our ability.
Spanish Translation Services
Why choose our Spanish translation services?

Translate your content into Spanish and engage with 500 million speakers worldwide
Our audiovisual translation services prioritize accuracy, cultural adaptation, and close synchronization.
Spanish is the second most spoken language in the world, and is the official language of 20 countries. However, the Spanish-speaking market is often neglected by multinationals who aren’t aware of the need to diversify the languages they offer.
Translating your professional documents into Spanish doesn’t only help your business reach foreign markets, but it also attracts key domestic audiences. From the tourism and leisure sector to engineering and law, BeTranslated provides you with bespoke Spanish translation services adapted to your area of expertise.

Spanish translation services provided by experienced native translators
As well as being one of the official languages of the European Union, Spanish is a key language for the tourism, technical, telecommunications, and IT industries.
Do you require professional translation services from English into European or Latin American Spanish? If so, we have an expert linguist for every regional variety of Spanish, and for every field or line of work.
For instance, if you require a translation of a user manual into Latin American Spanish, we will find a native technical translator, who will be assigned your project.
Spanish to English translation services

Translate your content from Spanish into English
With the growth of South American economies, Spanish will continue to have a significant global importance. Spain has forged strong economic ties with the whole world, and with the diversity of the Spanish-speaking world, it is important that your Word, InDesign, Excel, PowerPoint, or PDF documents are handled by someone with expert knowledge of the source culture and sector.
Likewise, our qualified Spanish to English translators have years of industry experience, and can provide you with fluent British or American English translations of your Spanish content, whatever your area of expertise.
We specialise in a wide range of fields, such as the business, financial, and legal sectors. We also offer subtitling services, as well as marketing and tourism translations.

Spanish: the language of a thriving tourism economy
Spanish is an omnipresent language in areas such as tourism, heritage, and hospitality. Spain and Mexico for example, are among the most visited countries in the world.
We adapt numerous tourist guides, websites, hotel brochures, and other documents that need to be translated to and from other languages, such as English, Dutch, French, German, or Italian.
Along with the usual file formats, we are also happy to assist you with your CMS solution, in order to provide continuous Spanish localisation services for your blog, online retail website, or company website.
Looking for an interpreter to help with legal, notary or medical consults?

Spanish interpreting services
Our Spanish interpreting services are essential for various professional settings, including business discussions, judicial procedures, and medical consultations.
They are particularly valuable for expatriates living in Spain, who may require interpreting services for legal, notary, or medical needs to deal with the local systems effectively.
Our skilled interpreters excel in both consecutive and simultaneous interpretation, adeptly handling sector-specific terminologies and the cultural conventions of Spanish communication.
We offer on-site and remote interpreting solutions to meet the logistical demands of our clients, keeping real-time communication clear in both languages.
Equipped with advanced technology for consistent service and a firm focus on confidentiality and professionalism, we help clients communicate confidently and effectively, whether face-to-face or online.
Opt for our comprehensive linguistic services to communicate with and build connections within the Spanish-speaking community.
Get in touch
Contact us today to find out more about our wide range of Spanish translation services.
Our Spanish translators
Vanessa
English to Spanish SEO copywriter and translator
Vanessa has a BA in Translation, as well as an MA in Audiovisual and Creative Translation. She is a freelance translator, who has many years of experience under her belt, and she translates from English and French into Spanish (Spain). She specialises in audiovisual translation, marketing, websites, SEO, and tourism.
Juan Carlos
Spanish technical translator
Juan Carlos is an independent professional translator based in Bern, Switzerland. Over the course of his long career, he has studied, worked, and lived in France, Spain, and Great Britain. He graduated with a degree in modern languages and translation from the University of Northumbria. He also holds a British Translation diploma (HND) in mechanical engineering from the University of Sunderland. He translates from English and French into Spanish, and from French and Spanish into British English.
Alicia
English to Spanish literary translator
Alicia is a highly skilled linguist, and she translates from English into French and Spanish, and from French into Spanish, and back again. She also interprets between French and Spanish. Her preferred fields are business, politics, literature, history, music, human rights, architecture, anthropology, ethnology, gastronomy, oenology, to name just a few.
Miguel
Experienced all-round translator
Miguel has been working with BeTranslated for many years. He translates from English and French into Spanish. A frequent traveller, he has lived and studied in the States, the Dominican Republic, the Netherlands, and Spain. Miguel specialises in marketing translations, as well as literary and editorial texts. His talents are highly regarded by BeTranslated’s most attentive customers.
